geometry_strategy: Approved Rev29 fit envelope, drawer body, front field, two-row beaded frame, and number standard preserved. The six simplified motif families are removed and replaced with rounded, layered printable relief assemblies closely modeled from the user-provided reference. Body facets are subdivided without changing their surfaces to improve the peppermint color boundary.

color_mapping.name: White Silk PLA
color_mapping.role: peppermint sectors, candy-cane stripes, snowflakes, and angels

color_mapping.name: Candy Red Silk PLA
color_mapping.role: raised numbers, hearts, and peppermint/candy-cane sectors

color_mapping.name: Gold Silk PLA
color_mapping.role: double-beaded frame, stars, angel halos, and tree toppers

number_standard.rule: same height, depth, vertical center, and horizontal group center as drawer 1; two-digit numbers remain centered as a pair

material_order_note: All 24 files include the same five materials in the same order for consistent slicer/AMS assignment.
